```{=typst}
// ==============================================================================
// RUNNING HEADERS AND FOOTERS (from the table of contents onwards)
// ==============================================================================
// Page numbering restarts at 1 here. The chapter title shown in the header is
// the current level-1 heading (or "Aurkibidea" before the first chapter).

#counter(page).update(1)

#set page(
  header: context {
    let p = counter(page).get().first()
    let cur-page = here().page()
    let page-headings = query(heading.where(level: 1)).filter(h => h.location().page() == cur-page)
    let is-chapter-start = page-headings.len() > 0
    let chap = if is-chapter-start {
      page-headings.first().body
    } else {
      let prev-headings = query(selector(heading.where(level: 1)).before(here()))
      if prev-headings.len() > 0 {
        prev-headings.last().body
      } else {
        [Aurkibidea]
      }
    }

    if calc.even(p) {
      // Even page: chapter title (left) | work type (right)
      grid(
        columns: (1fr, auto),
        align(left)[#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"), font: "EHUSans")[#chap]],
        align(right)[#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"), font: "EHUSans")[#lan-mota]]
      )
    } else if is-chapter-start {
      // Odd page where a chapter starts: work type (left) | author (right)
      grid(
        columns: (auto, 1fr),
        align(left)[#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"), font: "EHUSans")[#lan-mota]],
        align(right)[#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"), font: "EHUSans")[#egilea]]
      )
    } else {
      // Other odd pages: work type (left) | chapter title (right)
      grid(
        columns: (auto, 1fr),
        align(left)[#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"), font: "EHUSans")[#lan-mota]],
        align(right)[#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"), font: "EHUSans")[#chap]]
      )
    }
    // Thin UNIBERDEA rule under the header
    v(0.3em)
    line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#5FD790"))
  },
  footer: context {
    let p = counter(page).get().first()
    if calc.even(p) {
      // Even page: page number on the outer (left) side
      align(left)[#text(size: 9pt, weight: "bold", font: "EHUSans")[#p]]
    } else {
      // Odd page: page number on the outer (right) side
      align(right)[#text(size: 9pt, weight: "bold", font: "EHUSans")[#p]]
    }
  }
)

// ==============================================================================
// TABLE OF CONTENTS (AURKIBIDEA), headings down to level 3
// ==============================================================================
#outline(title: "Aurkibidea", depth: 3)
```
